items.p: Footings, frame, lock-up, fit-out. Hold the build at any one of them and walk in.
A real site covers its own work as it goes. Here the cavity, the footing and the connection stay open.
Zero site risk. No PPE, no inductions. Run the same stage as many times as it takes.
Runs on the Windows and macOS laptops students already own. No headset, no lab booking.
Students go where they want, the way they would in a game, and repeat whatever did not land.
Tune the depth to the cohort. The same build serves a first-year class and a final-year one.
